pr_title: Fix: Fixed an issue where dragging or opening multiple items would use the wrong sort mode
pr_body:
**Resolved / Related Issues**

- Closes #8534 
- Closes #15308 

**Steps used to test these changes**

These changes make the behavior of opening or dragging and dropping multiple files consistent with Files Explorer.

1. Prepare 6 video files, named 1-6
2. Select them in any order
3. Click play all on tool bar or enter on keyboard
4. The 6 files open in the player in the same order as they appear in the file list
5. Set sorting to "by name ascending"
6. Select the 6 files in any order
7. Right-click on file 3, choose "Open" from the menu
8. The 6 files open in the player in the order: 3 -> 4 -> 5 -> 6 -> 1 -> 2
9. Select the 6 files in any order
10. Drag file 3 and drop on a Windows Media Player window
11. The 6 files open in the player in the order: 3 -> 4 -> 5 -> 6 -> 1 -> 2
pr_comments: @Qin-shihuang thank you! I previously attempted to fix this but couldn't get the logic quite right, really appreciate your help on this!

issue_context.title: Bug: Files doesn't open items by file name and uses selection order
issue_context.body:
### Description

*

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Using Windows media player and 6 videos files named 1 to 6
2. Drag select items starting from 6 to 1
3. Click play all on tool bar or enter on keyboard
4. See video files added to queue 6 to 1
5. Select from 1 to 6
6. Click play all on tool bar or enter on keyboard
7. See video files added to queue 1 to 6

### Requirements

- Make opening files always be based on file name order rather than selection order

### Files Version

3.3.6.0

### Windows Version

10.0.22621.3447

### Log File

[debug.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/15214052/debug.log)
[debug_server.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/15214053/debug_server.log)
